beats.label: S1 · Jinchūriki revealed
beats.text: After failing his Academy graduation, Naruto is tricked into stealing a forbidden scroll and learns he carries the Nine-Tails fox that devastated Konoha twelve years ago.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes Naruto's dual identity — hero-in-training and demon vessel — that drives every conflict from here on.

beats.label: S1 · Team 7 forms
beats.text: Assigned to Team 7 with rival Sasuke and crush Sakura under Jōnin Kakashi, Naruto passes a test designed to fail them by showing they'll defy orders for each other.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Locks in the Naruto/Sasuke/Sakura/Kakashi unit whose bonds and fractures are the show's spine.

beats.label: S1 · Land of Waves
beats.text: Escorting a bridge builder home, Team 7 clashes with Rogue Ninja Zabuza and his ice-wielding apprentice Haku, both hired by the tyrant Gatō to kill their client.
beats.whyLoadBearing: First real mission establishes the Rogue Ninja pattern and the ideology — tools vs. bonds — Naruto will carry forward.

beats.label: S1 · Sharingan awakens
beats.text: Trapped in Haku's ice mirrors, Sasuke shields Naruto from a killing blow and awakens the Uchiha Sharingan; Naruto's grief taps the Nine-Tails' chakra for the first time.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Both signature powers — Sasuke's Sharingan and Naruto's fox-chakra — surface here and define every fight after.

beats.label: S1 · Chūnin Exams begin
beats.text: Back in Konoha, Team 7 is nominated for the Chūnin Exams and meets the Sand siblings — including the unsettling Gaara, whose own brother is terrified of him.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces Gaara and the Sand Village, whose intentions are the axis of the coming exam arc.

beats.label: S1 · Orochimaru's mark
beats.text: In the Forest of Death, the rogue Sannin Orochimaru — disguised as a Grass Genin — attacks Sasuke, brands him with a cursed mark, and promises he'll come back for its power.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The mark is the seed of Sasuke's defection arc; Orochimaru's infiltration reframes the exam as a strike on Konoha itself.

beats.label: S1 · Sakura's stand
beats.text: With Sasuke unconscious from the mark and Naruto sealed by Orochimaru, Sakura cuts her hair to break a Sound Genin's grip; Ino, Shikamaru and Chōji arrive to back her up.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Confirms Sakura as a fighter and puts Ino-Shika-Chō in the field, redrawing rookie alliances mid-exam.

cliffhanger.text: Team 7 is stranded deep in the Forest of Death mid-exam. Sasuke carries an unknown cursed mark placed by a legendary rogue ninja who has openly claimed him, Naruto's chakra is sealed, and the Sound trio pressing them has just been met head-on by Ino, Shikamaru and Chōji.
questions: What does Orochimaru's cursed mark do to Sasuke, and how far will he chase its power?
Can Team 7 collect both scrolls and reach the tower before the exam runs out?
What is Gaara really — and what happens when the exam turns to open combat?

characters.name: Naruto Uzumaki
characters.line: Genin of Team 7 and jinchūriki of the Nine-Tailed Fox; orphan raised in ridicule who has declared he'll become Hokage.

characters.name: Sasuke Uchiha
characters.line: Naruto's rival on Team 7 and sole survivor of a clan massacre; awakened his Sharingan in the Land of Waves and now bears Orochimaru's cursed mark.

characters.name: Sakura Haruno
characters.line: Third member of Team 7 and longtime Sasuke fangirl; just cut her hair in the Forest of Death to defend both unconscious teammates alone.

characters.name: Kakashi Hatake
characters.line: Team 7's Jōnin sensei, a copy-ninja whose left eye is a transplanted Sharingan; deceptively lazy demeanour hides an elite reputation.

characters.name: Gaara
characters.line: Sand Village Genin at the Chūnin Exams; disturbingly calm, disturbingly violent, and even his older brother Kankurō won't cross him.

characters.name: Orochimaru
characters.line: Rogue Sannin and Anko's former teacher; infiltrated the exam disguised as a Grass Genin to brand Sasuke and mark him as his own.

characters.name: Kabuto Yakushi
characters.line: Suspiciously helpful veteran Chūnin candidate handing out detailed intel on every rookie in the room, including the Sand siblings and Rock Lee.

characters.name: Hiruzen Sarutobi
characters.line: Third Hokage; approved Team 7's entry into the exams without knowing his former student Orochimaru had already targeted Sasuke.
